scope: DHAT cumulative allocated bytes and blocks, including reallocations as reported by DHAT. Marginal estimate is (500-50)/450 operations, identical 10 warmups. Each fanout/deep-concurrent operation contains 32 RPCs. Not retained memory or peak live bytes.
report_selection: All raw totals; top 20 allocating sites by marginal block count. Complete DHAT stacks and all site attribution are in the evidence archive.
